answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 39562 Country: India Title: The followers of Shafai madhhab are performing ghaibana namaz-e-janaza Question: The followers of Shafai madhhab are performing ghaibana namaz-e-janaza; is it permissible for Hanafi madhab followers to perform the same. Answer ID: 39562 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1359/1088/B=1433) Janazah salah is fardh kifayah i.e. if some Muslims offer it then this fardh shall be fulfilled from all the Muslims. Ghaibana namaz janazah is not established as per Hanafi Fiqh hence a Hanafi needs not to join it, he just should keep on supplicating for the maghfirah (forgiveness) of the deceased, it is enough. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
